description: Nilo, un minuscule dragon qui rêve de devenir pompier, découvre que sa petite taille peut sauver une vie quand aucun adulte ne peut atteindre un chaton prisonnier d'un appartement enfumé.
styleGlobal: PREMIUM STYLIZED 3D ANIMATED FEATURE FILM. Original character designs, warm expressive shapes, polished soft materials, clear silhouettes, cinematic but playful lighting, strong readable facial acting and natural physical contact. Native vertical 9:16. Never photorealistic, no realistic scales, fur or skin, no existing franchise resemblance, no copied logo, no watermark.

personnages.NILO: Very small young dragon, approximately knee-high to Captain Alma. Compact rounded teal-blue body, cream belly and muzzle, two short swept-back ivory horns, large amber eyes, tiny folded wings, three fingers on each small hand, one short thick tail. Miniature dark-navy firefighter jacket with two simple yellow reflective bands, tan boots and bright red firefighter helmet visibly one size too big. Same face, scales, proportions, colors and clothing in every scene.
personnages.CAPTAIN_ALMA: Adult female anthropomorphic grey wolf, tall upright human body proportions, silver-grey fur, pale muzzle, warm brown eyes, strong brows, competent demeanor, initially skeptical but kind. Dark-navy firefighter turnout coat with two yellow reflective bands, navy trousers, black boots and red helmet. Fur-covered human-shaped hands with five fingers. Same age, voice, markings, uniform and helmet in every scene.
personnages.KITTEN: Tiny ordinary four-legged orange tabby kitten, cream muzzle, green eyes. No speech and no human behavior. Same stripe pattern and size throughout. After being inside the smoky room, one small white feather remains visibly caught high in its back fur until the sneeze scene.

reglesRealisation.premiereImage: Every scene image is the EXACT FIRST FRAME of its video clip, never a montage and never an earlier or later event.
reglesRealisation.agnes: Agnes animates the supplied source image only. The source image defines all characters, hands, objects, architecture, positions and camera geometry.
reglesRealisation.geometrie: Every physical object needed for the action must already exist in the first frame. Agnes must never invent a hand, opening, ladder, door, tool or character.
reglesRealisation.continuite: Preserve character identity, scale, clothing, architecture and screen direction exactly.
reglesRealisation.contact: Hands, feet and props remain physically contact-correct. No floating feet, intersecting bodies, duplicate limbs or extra fingers.
reglesRealisation.niloTaille: Nilo remains very small in every shot, roughly knee-high to Alma. Never enlarge him to child-human size.
reglesRealisation.niloMains: Nilo always has exactly THREE fingers on each hand.
reglesRealisation.almaMains: Alma always has human-shaped fur-covered FIVE-finger hands.
reglesRealisation.chaton: Kitten always remains an ordinary four-legged kitten and never acts anthropomorphic.
reglesRealisation.camera: One motivated camera move maximum per clip. No random orbit or impossible repositioning.
reglesRealisation.dialogue: Only the explicitly designated speaker talks. Every other visible character has mouth closed and zero lip-sync.
reglesRealisation.incendie: Fire remains modest and contained, never engulfing Nilo or the kitten. Smoke mostly stays higher in the room so the rescue path remains readable.
